about: First-click tasks for the whole-site review of October 2026. Each task starts on the screen named by state and vp (states.mjs plus states-site.mjs). hit = controls on the path to doing the task (a closed menu that holds the control counts); near = a reasonable first step that is not on the path; scroll = the control is below the first screen, so 'I would scroll' is a right first move.
